stops.name: Zemmtal valley
stops.quote: Only from Mayrhofen, where the Zillertal splits into the narrow Zemmtal valley with the mountaineering village of Ginzling and the Tuxertal valley, does it begin to rise sharply.
stops.english: Only from Mayrhofen, where the Zillertal splits into the narrow Zemmtal valley with the mountaineering village of Ginzling and the Tuxertal valley, does it begin to rise sharply.

stops.name: Zillertal Railway
stops.quote: The Zillertal Railway, a modern means of transport that is still partly operated by nostalgic steam locomotives, fits in with this in a way.

stops.name: Zillertal Alps High Mountain Nature Park
stops.quote: The greatest scenic sensation is the Zillertal Alps High Mountain Nature Park, its 80 glaciers and the numerous three-thousand metre peaks with the Hochfeiler (3,509 metres) as the highest elevation.
stops.english: The greatest scenic sensation is the Zillertal Alps High Mountain Nature Park, its 80 glaciers and the numerous three-thousand metre peaks with the Hochfeiler (3,509 metres) as the highest elevation.

stops.name: Arena Coaster
stops.quote: The Arena Coaster summer toboggan run is ideal for children (but adults will also get their money's worth here - we promise!).

stops.name: Beer Adventure World
stops.quote: For beer drinkers, the Beer Adventure World is an absolute must.

stops.name: Mayrhofen adventure pool
stops.quote: For bad weather days, we recommend the beer adventure world for the grown-ups or the Mayrhofen adventure pool or the Erlebnistherme Zillertal for the family.
